info.name: WalletPay - Automated API Quality Assurance & Validation Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive Software Testing & Quality Assurance Suite for WalletPay Digital Wallet System.
Organized into 7 testing categories covering 39 test assertions:
- Group A: Functional Testing
- Group B: Boundary Value Analysis
- Group C: Input Validation Testing
- Group D: Integration Testing
- Group E: Database Consistency Testing
- Group F: Performance & Latency Testing
- Group G: Basic Security Testing
Compatible with Postman Desktop and Postman Collection Runner.
